generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Bidder shall upload Liquid assets worth Rs.15.25 lakhs (not less than 30% of the tender amount i.e 50.84 Lakhs) in the form of credit line/line of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirements etc. Also bidder shall upload Minimum quantities- of work executed in any one year (for continuous period of 12 months) during previous five years period. (80% of the tender qty) Pure polyurea (1is to1) waterproof membrane-1507 Sqm

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in tender in bill of quantities in the website itself.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work at his own cost.
The Bidder shall quote rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess etc., as per the prevailing regulations of GoI and GoK.

Any variation in GST during the contract period upward/ downward shall be paid or recovered. The Contractor and KPCL have agreed for the same. All payments towards variation in GST shall be on production of documentary proof.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit(MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be levied as per statutory norms issued by GoK.
As per Building and other construction workers Welfare Cess Act 1995, 1% Cess on bill amount shall be recovered in the work bills.
KPCL shall recover the statutory taxes such as Income Tax, cess, etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.
The contractor should get registration under section 7 & workers under section 12 of the building and other construction workers as per regulation of employment and condition of service act 1996.
Date of handing over of site shall be considered as date of commencement of work.
All other conditions are as per bid document.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing leakproof treatment to to roof of permanent residential and non-residential buildings at Ambikanagar

itemList.description: Demolishing brick work manually/by mechanical means including stacking of serviceable material and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.-In cement mortar.

Chipping unsound weak concrete material from slabs. Beams, columns & roofs upto 50mm by manual means or by standard power driven percussion type including cleaning reinforcement with wire brush complete as per direction of Engineer incharge of work.

Providing 15mm cement plaster on the rough side of single or half brick wall of mix 1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Super structures of building , Road works, Water works, Irrigation works & super structure works of bridges upto 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators. The cost includes all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing & applying over well prepared even, well cured, sound, dry surface (ie; less than 5% surface moisture ), 2 coats of prepacked, dual component, solvent free epoxy primer, mixed in as supllied whole packs quantities using slow speeed, electrically driven mixing machine (max 300 rpm) mixed to a uniform, low viscous consistency & applied to surface by spray / brush/roller, immiidiately after mixing, well within it's spot life, so as to fully wet, penetrte & seal the surface. Incase of absorption into the surface, a 2nd coat to be applied followed by broadcast of fine quartz aggregates ( of nominal 0.5mm grain size) over wet & yet unset primed surface so as to adhere into the primer.Nitoprime of Fosroc / Dr Cipy Pidilite or equal & approved including filling surface cracks, all as per diretions of Engineer In Charge.

Providing, supplying & Applying on the Roof / Headrooms / Slab / Chajjas / Parapet / Water tank platforms high pressure sprayed on Elastomeric Liquid Applied membrane forming, Pure polyurea (1is to1) waterproof membrane applied pressure sprayed on using proprietary dual component sprayer proportioner graco sprayer, applied at min.150 bar to form a dense, compact, tough, impermeable, elastomeric membrane minimum 1.5mm dry film thickness, achieved in 2 wet on wet pass coats in cross hatch pattern, application applied perpendicular to first, forming membrane with minimum properties elongation greater than 300% Tear resistance greater than 65N/mm, Tensile greater than 15N/sqmm & bonded teanciouslyto primed host concrte surface to form a seamless, hole fre, uniform membrane including all access scaffolda, equipments, tools & tackles. Fosroc Polyurea / Securea SC Dr Cipy / Pidilite/ Asian make approved & approved all as per directions of Engineer Incharge .

Cleaning of under ground sump, Over Head R.C.C. Tank ( independent staging) including disposal of slit and rubbish, all as per direction of Engineer-in-Charge. The cleaning shall consist following operations:- (i)Tank shall be emptied of water by pumping & bottom shall be cleaned of silt and other deposits. (ii) Entire surface area of the sump shall then scrubbed thoroughly with wire brush etc. and pressure washed with water. (iii) Chlorination of RCC internal surface by liquid chlorine. (iv) The treated surface shall be dried using air jetting and all loose particles shall be removal from the surface. (v) Finally the surface shall be treated with ultraviolet radiation etc. as per direction of Engineer-in-Charge
Checking the surface for cracks, marking & exposing the cracks & joints by light chiselling / cutting using angle grinders along the cracks to a sound substrate ( approx upto 20mm X 20mm size).

Providing & applying multi component pre-packed epoxy putty to seal the cracks & joints well compacteed into the grooves to set to a tight seal, applied in multiple layers as necessary to ensure no sag & tight seal including reprofiling the joints so as to achieve a level/ even surface flush with wall / floor surface. Nitocote VF of Fosroc/ Cipoxy or suitable equal & approved, as per diections of Engineer in charge.

Providing and grouting with two component low viscous Moisture Insensitive Epoxy Injection Grout to strengthen the structure at cocrete cracks. The material having mixing ratio - (Base : Hardener) - 100:60 (by weight) compressive strength of 70N/mm2 in 7days as per BS6319:part 2, Flexural strength of 30N/mm2 in 7days as per BS6319:part 3, Tensile strength of 15N/mm2 in 7days as per BS6319:part 7, epoxy resin based injection grout meets the requirement of BS 6319 & ASTM C 881. The finished cost to include surface preparation, fixing of non-return valve injection packers at concrete cracks, seal the nozzles with polyester resin anchor grout Instant leak plug 0.2kg/nozzle. All the application procedure shall be as per the direction of the Engineer In charge.

Check the pipe outlets / penetrations in the walls & bore pack the surround of each penetration using non shrink grout trowel / flow applied to achieve a tight seal all as per directions & approval of Engineer in charge.
Providing & fixing GI mesh 3mm X 50mm X 50mm by suitable corrosion resistant anchoring onto prepared RC surfaces, to receive plaster.

Providng & applying 20mm C:S plaster (1:4) mixed with approved liquid integral waterproofing admixture to make good the removed plaster & finishing the RC surface flush, including curing etc complete as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Providng & applying triangular edge coving at junction of base & walls of size approx 75mm X 75mm using CM 1:4 inlcuding applying Nitobond bonding agent & admixed with intergral waterproofing admixture, finished to a dense compaction, even surface, including curing complete as per the specifications and directions of Engineer in charge.

Preparing the interior base & vertical surfaces of the tank suitably using mechanical grinding, cleaning the surface to dust free surface condition, followed by appication of two coats of water based epoxy coating suitable & certified for contact with potable water, to a nominal DFT 300 microns as approved & directed by Engineer in charge.
